items.prompt: A minimalist flat vector illustration of a scientist looking through a magnifying glass. The scientist is depicted from the waist up, fully visible within the frame, with a curious expression. The magnifying glass lens subtly reflects a tiny magnified eye. The style features a thick, confident black outline, saturated but tasteful colors with soft 2-3 step cel-shading for a light sense of volume. The background is a pure, solid #00B140 chroma key green. The composition is centered in a 1:1 square aspect ratio, with the subject filling approximately 80% of the frame, leaving a clean, even margin of the green background visible on all four sides. There is no text, no shadow, and no environment. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and suitable for business presentations.
